blocking_finding.mechanism: orchestrator.py:1514-1518 -- _is_native_eligible_without_ocr returns True unconditionally under config.native_only, BEFORE the needs_ocr_enhancement check. The page therefore entered the PP-7 chart-asset lane, whose winner carries engine='chart_asset'. The contradiction guard at the top of _winning_page_output was keyed on (engine or '').startswith('native'), so the chart winner returned immediately and the round-1 fail-closed floor never ran: confetti shipped under SUCCESS.

lane_enumeration.method: drove process() over the full pipeline-config matrix on three fixtures (shredded rotated figure page / clean rotated chart page / upright page), recording shipped engine, page status, count of <=2-char lines in the shipped text, and document status. A lane 'LEAKS' iff document status is success AND the shipped text contains confetti.
axes: with raster (chart marks present) vs no raster (chart lane cannot intercept)
single run vs resumed run (second process() restores the terminal ledger entry -- the #214 shape)

leaking: agentic --native-only + save_figures -> engine=chart_asset status=success confetti=15 doc=success (same lane)
resume x2 agentic --native-only  -> engine=chart_asset status=success confetti=15 (same lane, restored winner)
already_safe: no-raster variants, all three agentic modes -> engine=native status=error confetti=0

lane_enumeration.conclusion: chart_asset is the ONLY leaking lane. There is no third lane. The plain native bypass under --native-only and every deterministic path already reached the floor because their winner is engine='native', which the existing guard caught.
lane_enumeration.after_fix: every SHRED row reads engine=native status=error confetti=0 doc=error; every CLEAN and UPRIGHT row is byte-for-byte unchanged from before the fix.

fix.change: new module constant _NATIVE_TEXT_LANES = ('native', 'chart_asset') -- the engines whose winning text IS PageState.native_text (the chart lane appends a PNG ref to it). The shred term of the contradiction guard is scoped to those lanes via startswith(_NATIVE_TEXT_LANES) instead of the bare 'native' prefix. The TABLE flags deliberately keep the narrower 'native' scope: they concern a native table reconstruction, which only the native lane performs.
fix.png_preservation: the chart lane hands the PNG it ALREADY rendered to ps.rotated_shred_png_ref, so the floor ships marker + image rather than a bare marker and nothing is rendered twice. The ref is written to the page sidecar and restored on resume next to d3_floor_png_ref, so a resumed run does not silently degrade to a bare marker.
fix.routing_deliberately_unchanged: _is_chart_asset_page was NOT narrowed. On a chart page the image is the content and the page is still a chart page; only its text half is refused. Narrowing the predicate would discard the PNG on every flagged page for no gain, and would enlarge the blast radius on good chart pages -- the stated failure mode of this change.

reverse_guards_round2: test_clean_rotated_chart_page_keeps_the_chart_asset_lane -- a rotated chart page that is NOT shredded still takes the lane (engine == 'chart_asset'), still ships SUCCESS, still carries '![Chart page 1](...)', caption intact. PASSES at 220e00d and on 8be326e.
test_upright_chart_page_keeps_the_chart_asset_lane -- unrotated chart page untouched, chart_asset SUCCESS with its PNG. PASSES at 220e00d and on 8be326e.
plus every CLEAN and UPRIGHT row of the 20-configuration sweep, unchanged before and after the fix.
